sections.label: COVID-19 pandemic disrupting businesses
sections.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic has disrupted businesses and livelihoods and is the most serious challenge since Independence.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has disrupted businesses and livelihoods.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: It is the most serious challenge we have faced since Independence.

sections.label: Opening economy safely and sustainably
sections.summary: The first step is to open the economy safely and sustainably, enabling businesses to resume with safe management measures, testing and contact tracing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Our first step will be to open our economy safely and sustainably, because it will be difficult to generate economic growth otherwise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will enable businesses to resume progressively and manage the risks with tight safe management measures for higher-risk activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will expand our testing and contact tracing capacity significantly, so that we can isolate clusters swiftly and effectively, to allow the rest of the economy to continue operating.

sections.label: Industry Transformation Maps sector support
sections.summary: Industry Transformation Maps will provide sector-specific support, with MTI partnering businesses and workers to reopen the economy safely and sustainably.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will leverage our Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs) to provide sector-specific support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We are confronting this crisis from a position of strength.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Our hard-won reputation for transparency, rule of law, skilled workforce, and world-class connectivity are significant advantages, and will enable us to adapt to the challenging environment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: MTI will partner businesses, workers, and other stakeholders to forge a new path ahead.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will reopen our economy safely and sustainably, help businesses and workers adjust, and establish a conducive environment for businesses and workers to grow, to realise our vision of a vibrant economy with opportunities for all.
